name: Updates animal status, creates alerts, and updates related events
script:
# Server Script Name: Animal Event - After Submit # DocType: Animal Event # Event: After Submit # Description: Updates animal status, creates alerts, and updates related events # NO IMPORTS, NO DEFS, NO RETURNS - SANDBOX COMPATIBLE # ============================================================ # UPDATE ANIMAL STATUS ON ASSET # ============================================================ animal = frappe.get_doc("Animal", doc.animal) if doc.event_type == "Service": # Update reproductive status on Asset if animal.meta.has_field("repro_status"): animal.repro_status = "Served" if animal.meta.has_field("last_service_date"): animal.last_service_date = doc.service_date if animal.meta.has_field("custom_pregnancy_status"): animal.custom_pregnancy_status = "Pending Check" animal.save(ignore_permissions=True) # Create pregnancy check alert/reminder if doc.pregnancy_check_due_date: existing_todo = frappe.db.exists({ "doctype": "ToDo", "reference_type": "Animal Event", "reference_name": doc.name, "status": ["!=", "Cancelled"] }) if not existing_todo: todo = frappe.get_doc({ "doctype": "ToDo", "description": f"""🔍 Pregnancy Check Due
Animal: {doc.animal}
Service Date: {frappe.utils.formatdate(doc.service_date)}
Check Due: {frappe.utils.formatdate(doc.pregnancy_check_due_date)}
Event: {doc.name}""", "reference_type": "Animal Event", "reference_name": doc.name, "assigned_by": frappe.session.user, "priority": "Medium", "date": doc.pregnancy_check_due_date, "status": "Open" }) # Assign to operator if exists if doc.operator: operator_user = frappe.db.get_value("Employee", doc.operator, "user_id") if operator_user: todo.allocated_to = operator_user todo.insert(ignore_permissions=True) pass if doc.event_type == "Pregnancy Diagnosis": # Update the related service event if doc.related_service: service = frappe.get_doc("Animal Event", doc.related_service) if doc.diagnosis_result == "Confirmed": service.db_set("pregnancy_confirmation_status", "Confirmed", update_modified=False) service.db_set("service_status", "Successful", update_modified=False) service.db_set("pregnancy_confirmation_date", doc.diagnosis_date, update_modified=False) if service.meta.has_field("custom_status_after_test"): service.db_set("custom_status_after_test", "Successful", update_modified=False) # Update animal to pregnant if animal.meta.has_field("repro_status"): animal.repro_status = "Pregnant" if animal.meta.has_field("custom_pregnancy_status"): animal.custom_pregnancy_status = "Confirmed" if animal.meta.has_field("expected_calving_date") and service.meta.has_field("expected_calving_date"): animal.expected_calving_date = service.expected_calving_date animal.save(ignore_permissions=True) # Create calving alert if service.meta.has_field("expected_calving_date") and service.expected_calving_date: alert_date = frappe.utils.add_days(service.expected_calving_date, -7) existing_calving_todo = frappe.db.exists({ "doctype": "ToDo", "reference_type": "Animal Event", "reference_name": doc.related_service, "description": ["like", "%Calving Expected%"], "status": ["!=", "Cancelled"] }) if not existing_calving_todo: todo = frappe.get_doc({ "doctype": "ToDo", "description": f"""🐄 Calving Expected Soon
Animal: {doc.animal}
Expected Date: {frappe.utils.formatdate(service.expected_calving_date)}
Service: {doc.related_service}

Prepare calving area and monitor closely.""", "reference_type": "Animal Event", "reference_name": doc.related_service, "priority": "High", "date": alert_date, "status": "Open" }) todo.insert(ignore_permissions=True) pass elif doc.diagnosis_result in ["Not Pregnant", "Aborted"]: service.db_set("pregnancy_confirmation_status", doc.diagnosis_result, update_modified=False) service.db_set("service_status", "Failed", update_modified=False) if service.meta.has_field("custom_status_after_test"): service.db_set("custom_status_after_test", "Failed", update_modified=False) # Update animal to open if animal.meta.has_field("repro_status"): animal.repro_status = "Open" if animal.meta.has_field("custom_pregnancy_status"): animal.custom_pregnancy_status = "Not Pregnant" animal.save(ignore_permissions=True) # Add comment to service service.add_comment("Info", text=f"""Updated by Pregnancy Diagnosis: {doc.name}""") pass if doc.event_type == "Calving": # Update animal status if animal.meta.has_field("repro_status"): animal.repro_status = "Open" if animal.meta.has_field("custom_pregnancy_status"): animal.custom_pregnancy_status = "Not Pregnant" if animal.meta.has_field("last_calving_date"): animal.last_calving_date = doc.event_date # Increment lactation number if animal.meta.has_field("parity"): current_lactation = animal.parity or 0 animal.parity = current_lactation + 1 animal.save(ignore_permissions=True) # Create re-breeding alert if doc.meta.has_field("ready_for_service_date") and doc.ready_for_service_date: existing_rebreeding_todo = frappe.db.exists({ "doctype": "ToDo", "reference_type": "Animal Event", "reference_name": doc.name, "description": ["like", "%Ready for Re-breeding%"], "status": ["!=", "Cancelled"] }) if not existing_rebreeding_todo: todo = frappe.get_doc({ "doctype": "ToDo", "description": f"""🔄 Ready for Re-breeding
Animal: {doc.animal}
Calved: {frappe.utils.formatdate(doc.event_date)}
Ready from: {frappe.utils.formatdate(doc.ready_for_service_date)}

Animal has completed voluntary waiting period.""", "reference_type": "Animal Event", "reference_name": doc.name, "priority": "Medium", "date": doc.ready_for_service_date, "status": "Open" }) todo.insert(ignore_permissions=True) pass # Movement herd update + herd-count recompute are handled solely by the # herd_movement_processor script. Doing it here (Before Insert) would pre-empt # that script and suppress its number_of_animals recompute, so it is omitted. # Commit all changes pass

name: herd_movement_processor
script:
# Updated Server Script for Herd Movement
# Set Event to: "After Submit"

if doc.event_type == "Movement" and doc.animal and doc.new_herd:
    try:
        # Get the previous herd BEFORE updating
        previous_herd = frappe.db.get_value("Animal", doc.animal, "current_herd")
        
        # Only proceed if there's an actual herd change
        if previous_herd != doc.new_herd:
            # Update the animal's current herd
            frappe.db.set_value("Animal", doc.animal, "current_herd", doc.new_herd)
            
            # Update OLD herd count (if there was a previous herd)
            if previous_herd:
                old_count = frappe.db.count("Animal", {"current_herd": previous_herd, "docstatus": ["!=", 2]})
                frappe.db.set_value("Herds", previous_herd, "number_of_animals", old_count)
            
            # Update NEW herd count
            new_count = frappe.db.count("Animal", {"current_herd": doc.new_herd, "docstatus": ["!=", 2]})
            frappe.db.set_value("Herds", doc.new_herd, "number_of_animals", new_count)
            
            frappe.msgprint(f"Animal {doc.animal} successfully moved from {previous_herd or 'no herd'} to {doc.new_herd}")
        else:
            frappe.msgprint("No herd change detected")
        
    except Exception as e:
        frappe.log_error(message=str(e), title="Herd Movement Error")
        frappe.throw(f"Error: Could not update animal herd - {str(e)}")

name: VALIDATION FOR SERVICE EVENTS
script:
# Server Script Name: Animal Event - Before Save Validation # DocType: Animal Event # Event: Before Save # Description: Validates service events, pregnancy diagnosis, and calving # NO IMPORTS, NO DEFS, NO RETURNS - SANDBOX COMPATIBLE # ============================================================ # VALIDATION FOR SERVICE EVENTS # ============================================================ if doc.event_type == "Service": # Rule 1: No second service without feedback on first service pending_services = frappe.db.sql(""" SELECT name, service_date, pregnancy_confirmation_status FROM `tabAnimal Event` WHERE animal = %s AND event_type = 'Service' AND docstatus = 1 AND pregnancy_confirmation_status = 'Pending' AND name != %s ORDER BY service_date DESC LIMIT 1 """, (doc.animal, doc.name or "new"), as_dict=True) if pending_services: last_service = pending_services[0] days_since = frappe.utils.date_diff(doc.service_date, last_service.service_date) frappe.throw(f"""⚠️ Cannot record new service!

This animal has a pending service from {frappe.utils.formatdate(last_service.service_date)} ({days_since} days ago).
Action Required: Complete pregnancy diagnosis for service {last_service.name} first.

Tip: Go to Animal Events → Find service → Record pregnancy diagnosis""") # Rule 2: Check if animal is already confirmed pregnant active_pregnancy = frappe.db.sql(""" SELECT ae.name, ae.service_date, ae.expected_calving_date FROM `tabAnimal Event` ae WHERE ae.animal = %s AND ae.event_type = 'Service' AND ae.pregnancy_confirmation_status = 'Confirmed' AND ae.docstatus = 1 AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM `tabAnimal Event` calving WHERE calving.animal = ae.animal AND calving.event_type = 'Calving' AND calving.custom_related_pregnancy = ae.name AND calving.docstatus = 1 ) ORDER BY ae.service_date DESC LIMIT 1 """, (doc.animal,), as_dict=True) if active_pregnancy: pregnancy = active_pregnancy[0] expected_calving = pregnancy.get("expected_calving_date") days_until = frappe.utils.date_diff(expected_calving, frappe.utils.nowdate()) if expected_calving else 0 frappe.throw(f"""🤰 Animal is Already Pregnant!

Service Date: {frappe.utils.formatdate(pregnancy.service_date)}
Expected Calving: {frappe.utils.formatdate(expected_calving) if expected_calving else 'Not set'}
Days Until Calving: {days_until} days

Action: Cannot service pregnant animals. Wait for calving.""") # Rule 3: Check post-partum waiting period last_calving = frappe.db.sql(""" SELECT name, event_date, custom_calving_outcome FROM `tabAnimal Event` WHERE animal = %s AND event_type = 'Calving' AND docstatus = 1 ORDER BY event_date DESC LIMIT 1 """, (doc.animal,), as_dict=True) if last_calving: calving = last_calving[0] days_since_calving = frappe.utils.date_diff(doc.service_date, calving.event_date) minimum_days = 45 optimal_days = 60 if days_since_calving < minimum_days: frappe.throw(f"""⚠️ Too Early for Service!

Last Calving: {frappe.utils.formatdate(calving.event_date)} ({days_since_calving} days ago)
Minimum Waiting Period: {minimum_days} days
Shortfall: {minimum_days - days_since_calving} days

Reason: Animal needs time for uterine involution and recovery.
Recommendation: Wait at least {minimum_days} days post-calving.""") elif days_since_calving < optimal_days: frappe.msgprint(f"""⚠️ Early Service Warning

Days since calving: {days_since_calving}
Optimal waiting period: {optimal_days} days

Note: Service is allowed but conception rates improve after {optimal_days} days.""", alert=True, indicator="orange") # Set initial pregnancy status if not doc.pregnancy_confirmation_status: doc.pregnancy_confirmation_status = "Pending" if not doc.service_status: doc.service_status = "Pending" # ============================================================ # VALIDATION FOR PREGNANCY DIAGNOSIS # ============================================================ if doc.event_type == "Pregnancy Diagnosis": # Must have related service if not doc.related_service: # Try to auto-find most recent pending service recent_service = frappe.db.sql(""" SELECT name, service_date FROM `tabAnimal Event` WHERE animal = %s AND event_type = 'Service' AND docstatus = 1 AND pregnancy_confirmation_status = 'Pending' ORDER BY service_date DESC LIMIT 1 """, (doc.animal,), as_dict=True) if recent_service: doc.related_service = recent_service[0].name frappe.msgprint(f"""Auto-linked to most recent service: {recent_service[0].name} from {frappe.utils.formatdate(recent_service[0].service_date)}""", alert=True, indicator="blue") else: frappe.throw("""❌ No Related Service Found!

This animal has no pending service to diagnose.

Action Required:
1. Ensure a service event has been recorded
2. Service must be submitted (not draft)
3. Service must have 'Pending' pregnancy status

Tip: Record the service event first, then come back to record diagnosis.""") # Validate timing service = frappe.get_doc("Animal Event", doc.related_service) if not service.service_date: frappe.throw(f"""Related service {doc.related_service} has no service date!""") if doc.diagnosis_date < service.service_date: frappe.throw(f"""⚠️ Invalid Diagnosis Date!

Diagnosis Date: {frappe.utils.formatdate(doc.diagnosis_date)}
Service Date: {frappe.utils.formatdate(service.service_date)}

Diagnosis cannot be before service date!""") days_since_service = frappe.utils.date_diff(doc.diagnosis_date, service.service_date) # Check timing appropriateness if days_since_service < 21: frappe.msgprint(f"""⚠️ Very Early Diagnosis

Days since service: {days_since_service}
Recommended minimum: 21 days

Note: Pregnancy detection accuracy is lower before 21 days.""", alert=True, indicator="orange") elif days_since_service > 70: frappe.msgprint(f"""⚠️ Very Late Diagnosis

Days since service: {days_since_service}
Recommended maximum: 70 days

Note: This diagnosis is overdue.""", alert=True, indicator="red") # Validate diagnosis result if not doc.diagnosis_result: frappe.throw("Please select a diagnosis result: Confirmed, Not Pregnant, or Aborted") # ============================================================ # VALIDATION FOR CALVING # ============================================================ if doc.event_type == "Calving": # Must link to pregnancy if not doc.custom_related_pregnancy: # Try to auto-find confirmed pregnancy pregnancy = frappe.db.sql(""" SELECT name, service_date, expected_calving_date FROM `tabAnimal Event` WHERE animal = %s AND event_type = 'Service' AND pregnancy_confirmation_status = 'Confirmed' AND docstatus = 1 AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM `tabAnimal Event` c WHERE c.custom_related_pregnancy = `tabAnimal Event`.name AND c.event_type = 'Calving' AND c.docstatus = 1 ) ORDER BY service_date DESC LIMIT 1 """, (doc.animal,), as_dict=True) if pregnancy: doc.custom_related_pregnancy = pregnancy[0].name frappe.msgprint(f"""Auto-linked to pregnancy from service: {pregnancy[0].name}""", alert=True, indicator="blue") else: frappe.throw("""❌ No Active Pregnancy Found!

This animal has no confirmed pregnancy to calve from.

Action Required:
1. Ensure a service has been recorded
2. Pregnancy must be confirmed via diagnosis
3. No previous calving recorded for this pregnancy

Tip: Complete the pregnancy confirmation first.""") # Validate gestation length service = frappe.get_doc("Animal Event", doc.custom_related_pregnancy) if service.service_date: gestation_days = frappe.utils.date_diff(doc.event_date, service.service_date) if gestation_days < 260: frappe.msgprint(f"""⚠️ Short Gestation Period!

Gestation Length: {gestation_days} days
Normal Range: 270-290 days

Note: This may indicate premature birth or abortion.""", alert=True, indicator="orange") elif gestation_days > 300: frappe.msgprint(f"""⚠️ Long Gestation Period!

Gestation Length: {gestation_days} days
Normal Range: 270-290 days

Note: Verify the dates are correct.""", alert=True, indicator="orange") # Validate calving outcome if not doc.custom_calving_outcome: frappe.throw("Please select the calving outcome: Live Birth, Still Birth, or Abortion") # ============================================================ # VALIDATION FOR MOVEMENT # ============================================================ if doc.event_type == "Movement": if not doc.current_herd: # Get current herd from animal animal_herd = frappe.db.get_value("Animal", doc.animal, "current_herd") if animal_herd: doc.current_herd = animal_herd if not doc.new_herd: frappe.throw("Please select the destination herd") if doc.current_herd == doc.new_herd: frappe.throw("Current herd and new herd cannot be the same!") # ============================================================ # CALCULATE DATES FOR ALL EVENTS # ============================================================ if doc.event_type == "Service" and doc.service_date: # Calculate expected calving date (280 days) doc.expected_calving_date = frappe.utils.add_days(doc.service_date, 280) # Calculate pregnancy check due date (35 days optimal) doc.pregnancy_check_due_date = frappe.utils.add_days(doc.service_date, 35) # Calculate next expected heat if fails (21-day cycle) doc.next_expected_heat = frappe.utils.add_days(doc.service_date, 21) if doc.event_type == "Calving" and doc.event_date: # Calculate when ready for re-breeding (60 days post-partum) doc.ready_for_service_date = frappe.utils.add_days(doc.event_date, 60)

name: Update Service from Diagnosis
script:
# --------------------------------------------
# RULE: Cow must calve before next pregnancy
# --------------------------------------------

if doc.event_type == "Pregnancy Diagnosis" and doc.diagnosis_result == "Confirmed":

    # 1. Get last confirmed pregnancy BEFORE this one
    last_pregnancy = frappe.db.get_list(
        "Animal Event",
        filters={
            "animal": doc.animal,
            "event_type": "Pregnancy Diagnosis",
            "diagnosis_result": "Confirmed",
            "docstatus": 1,
            "name": ["!=", doc.name],
        },
        fields=["name", "diagnosis_date"],
        order_by="diagnosis_date desc",
        limit=1
    )

    if last_pregnancy:
        last_pregnancy_date = last_pregnancy[0].diagnosis_date

        # 2. Check if a Calving event happened AFTER that pregnancy
        calving = frappe.db.exists(
            "Animal Event",
            {
                "animal": doc.animal,
                "event_type": "Calving",
                "event_date": [">", last_pregnancy_date],
                "docstatus": 1
            }
        )

        if not calving:
            frappe.throw(
                f"🐄 {doc.animal} is already pregnant.\n\n"
                "The cow must calve before a new pregnancy can be recorded."
            )

name: Get Animal Reproductive Summary
script:
# Server Script Name: API - Get Animal Reproductive Summary
# Script Type: API
# API Method: get_animal_reproductive_summary
# Description: Returns comprehensive reproductive summary for an animal
# NO IMPORTS, NO DEFS, NO RETURNS - SANDBOX COMPATIBLE

# Get the animal parameter
animal = frappe.form_dict.get("animal")

if not animal:
    frappe.throw("Animal parameter is required")

# Initialize summary
summary = {}

# Get current status from Asset
asset = frappe.get_doc("Animal", animal)
summary["current_status"] = (asset.get("repro_status") or "Unknown")
summary["pregnancy_status"] = (asset.get("custom_pregnancy_status") or "Unknown")

# Get last service
last_service = frappe.db.sql("""
    SELECT name, service_date, service_type, pregnancy_confirmation_status,
           expected_calving_date
    FROM `tabAnimal Event`
    WHERE animal = %s
    AND event_type = 'Service'
    AND docstatus = 1
    ORDER BY service_date DESC
    LIMIT 1
""", (animal,), as_dict=True)

if last_service:
    summary["last_service"] = last_service[0]
    summary["days_since_service"] = frappe.utils.date_diff(frappe.utils.nowdate(), last_service[0].service_date)

# Get pending checks
pending_checks = frappe.db.sql("""
    SELECT name, service_date, pregnancy_check_due_date
    FROM `tabAnimal Event`
    WHERE animal = %s
    AND event_type = 'Service'
    AND pregnancy_confirmation_status = 'Pending'
    AND docstatus = 1
""", (animal,), as_dict=True)

summary["pending_checks"] = pending_checks

# Get last calving
last_calving = frappe.db.sql("""
    SELECT name, event_date, custom_calving_outcome
    FROM `tabAnimal Event`
    WHERE animal = %s
    AND event_type = 'Calving'
    AND docstatus = 1
    ORDER BY event_date DESC
    LIMIT 1
""", (animal,), as_dict=True)

if last_calving:
    summary["last_calving"] = last_calving[0]
    summary["days_since_calving"] = frappe.utils.date_diff(frappe.utils.nowdate(), last_calving[0].event_date)

# Get service performance
total_services = frappe.db.count("Animal Event", {
    "animal": animal,
    "event_type": "Service",
    "docstatus": 1
})

successful_services = frappe.db.count("Animal Event", {
    "animal": animal,
    "event_type": "Service",
    "service_status": "Successful",
    "docstatus": 1
})

summary["total_services"] = total_services
summary["successful_services"] = successful_services
summary["conception_rate"] = (successful_services / total_services * 100) if total_services > 0 else 0

# Set response
frappe.response["message"] = summary

name: CHECK OVERDUE PREGNANCY DIAGNOSES
script:
# Server Script Name: Daily Reproductive Alerts # Script Type: Scheduler Event # Event Frequency: Daily # Description: Runs daily checks for pregnancy alerts, calvings, and problem animals # NO IMPORTS, NO DEFS, NO RETURNS - SANDBOX COMPATIBLE # ============================================================ # 1. CHECK OVERDUE PREGNANCY DIAGNOSES # ============================================================ overdue_services = frappe.db.sql(""" SELECT ae.name, ae.animal, a.burn_name AS asset_name, a.current_herd AS custom_current_herd, ae.service_date, ae.operator, DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), ae.service_date) as days_since FROM `tabAnimal Event` ae LEFT JOIN `tabAnimal` a ON ae.animal = a.name WHERE ae.event_type = 'Service' AND ae.pregnancy_confirmation_status = 'Pending' AND ae.docstatus = 1 AND DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), ae.service_date) > 60 AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM `tabToDo` t WHERE t.reference_type = 'Animal Event' AND t.reference_name = ae.name AND t.description LIKE '%Overdue%' AND t.status != 'Cancelled' AND DATE(t.creation) = CURDATE() ) """, as_dict=True) for service in overdue_services: todo = frappe.get_doc({ "doctype": "ToDo", "description": f"""🚨 OVERDUE: Pregnancy Check Required

Animal: {service.animal} ({service.asset_name or ''})
Herd: {service.custom_current_herd or 'Not assigned'}
Service Date: {frappe.utils.formatdate(service.service_date)}
Days Overdue: {service.days_since} days
Service Event: {service.name}

Action Required: Record pregnancy diagnosis immediately!""", "reference_type": "Animal Event", "reference_name": service.name, "priority": "High", "status": "Open", "date": frappe.utils.nowdate() }) # Assign to operator if exists if service.operator: operator_user = frappe.db.get_value("Employee", service.operator, "user_id") if operator_user: todo.allocated_to = operator_user todo.insert(ignore_permissions=True) frappe.db.commit() # ============================================================ # 2. CHECK UPCOMING CALVINGS (NEXT 7 DAYS) # ============================================================ upcoming_calvings = frappe.db.sql(""" SELECT ae.name, ae.animal, a.burn_name AS asset_name, a.current_herd AS custom_current_herd, ae.service_date, DATE_ADD(ae.service_date, INTERVAL 280 DAY) as expected_calving, DATEDIFF(DATE_ADD(ae.service_date, INTERVAL 280 DAY), CURDATE()) as days_until FROM `tabAnimal Event` ae LEFT JOIN `tabAnimal` a ON ae.animal = a.name WHERE ae.event_type = 'Service' AND ae.pregnancy_confirmation_status = 'Confirmed' AND ae.docstatus = 1 AND DATE_ADD(ae.service_date, INTERVAL 280 DAY) BETWEEN CURDATE() AND DATE_ADD(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 7 DAY) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM `tabAnimal Event` c WHERE c.custom_related_pregnancy = ae.name AND c.event_type = 'Calving' AND c.docstatus = 1 ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM `tabToDo` t WHERE t.reference_type = 'Animal Event' AND t.reference_name = ae.name AND t.description LIKE '%Calving Expected%' AND t.status != 'Cancelled' AND DATE(t.creation) >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 7 DAY) ) """, as_dict=True) for calving in upcoming_calvings: urgency = "High" if calving.days_until <= 3 else "Medium" todo = frappe.get_doc({ "doctype": "ToDo", "description": f"""🐄 Calving Expected Soon!

Animal: {calving.animal} ({calving.asset_name or ''})
Herd: {calving.custom_current_herd or 'Not assigned'}
Expected Date: {frappe.utils.formatdate(calving.expected_calving)}
Days Until Calving: {calving.days_until} days
Service Event: {calving.name}

Action Required:
• Prepare calving area
• Monitor animal closely
• Have calving kit ready""", "reference_type": "Animal Event", "reference_name": calving.name, "priority": urgency, "status": "Open", "date": calving.expected_calving }) todo.insert(ignore_permissions=True) frappe.db.commit() # ============================================================ # 3. CHECK ANIMALS READY FOR RE-BREEDING (EXACTLY 60 DAYS) # ============================================================ ready_animals = frappe.db.sql(""" SELECT ae.name, ae.animal, a.burn_name AS asset_name, a.current_herd AS custom_current_herd, ae.event_date as calving_date, DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), ae.event_date) as days_since_calving FROM `tabAnimal Event` ae LEFT JOIN `tabAnimal` a ON ae.animal = a.name WHERE ae.event_type = 'Calving' AND ae.docstatus = 1 AND ae.custom_calving_outcome = 'Live Birth' AND DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), ae.event_date) = 60 AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM `tabAnimal Event` s WHERE s.animal = ae.animal AND s.event_type = 'Service' AND s.service_date > ae.event_date AND s.pregnancy_confirmation_status = 'Confirmed' AND s.docstatus = 1 ) """, as_dict=True) for animal in ready_animals: todo = frappe.get_doc({ "doctype": "ToDo", "description": f"""✅ Animal Ready for Re-breeding!

Animal: {animal.animal} ({animal.asset_name or ''})
Herd: {animal.custom_current_herd or 'Not assigned'}
Last Calving: {frappe.utils.formatdate(animal.calving_date)}
Days Since Calving: {animal.days_since_calving} days

Action: Watch for heat signs and service when detected.""", "reference_type": "Animal Event", "reference_name": animal.name, "priority": "Medium", "status": "Open", "date": frappe.utils.nowdate() }) todo.insert(ignore_permissions=True) frappe.db.commit() # ============================================================ # 4. CHECK EXPECTED HEAT CYCLES (21 DAYS AFTER FAILED SERVICE) # ============================================================ expected_heats = frappe.db.sql(""" SELECT ae.name, ae.animal, a.burn_name AS asset_name, a.current_herd AS custom_current_herd, ae.service_date, ae.pregnancy_confirmation_status, DATE_ADD(ae.service_date, INTERVAL 21 DAY) as expected_heat_date FROM `tabAnimal Event` ae LEFT JOIN `tabAnimal` a ON ae.animal = a.name WHERE ae.event_type = 'Service' AND ae.pregnancy_confirmation_status IN ('Not Pregnant', 'Aborted', 'Failed') AND ae.docstatus = 1 AND DATE_ADD(ae.service_date, INTERVAL 21 DAY) = CURDATE() AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM `tabAnimal Event` s2 WHERE s2.animal = ae.animal AND s2.event_type = 'Service' AND s2.service_date > ae.service_date AND s2.docstatus = 1 ) """, as_dict=True) for heat in expected_heats: todo = frappe.get_doc({ "doctype": "ToDo", "description": f"""🔥 Expected Heat Today!

Animal: {heat.animal} ({heat.asset_name or ''})
Herd: {heat.custom_current_herd or 'Not assigned'}
Last Service: {frappe.utils.formatdate(heat.service_date)}
Last Result: {heat.pregnancy_confirmation_status}
Expected Heat: Today (21-day cycle)

Action: Watch for heat signs and service if detected.""", "reference_type": "Animal Event", "reference_name": heat.name, "priority": "Medium", "status": "Open", "date": frappe.utils.nowdate() }) todo.insert(ignore_permissions=True) frappe.db.commit() # ============================================================ # 5. IDENTIFY PROBLEM ANIMALS (REPEAT BREEDERS) # ============================================================ repeat_breeders = frappe.db.sql(""" SELECT animal, asset_name, service_count, last_service_date FROM ( SELECT ae.animal, a.burn_name AS asset_name, a.current_herd AS custom_current_herd, COUNT(*) as service_count, MAX(ae.service_date) as last_service_date FROM `tabAnimal Event` ae LEFT JOIN `tabAnimal` a ON ae.animal = a.name WHERE ae.event_type = 'Service' AND ae.docstatus = 1 GROUP BY ae.animal, a.burn_name, a.current_herd HAVING COUNT(*) >= 3 AND SUM(CASE WHEN ae.pregnancy_confirmation_status = 'Confirmed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 0 ) as repeat_breeders WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM `tabToDo` t WHERE t.reference_type = 'Animal' AND t.reference_name = repeat_breeders.animal AND t.description LIKE '%Repeat Breeder%' AND t.status != 'Cancelled' AND DATE(t.creation) >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 30 DAY) ) """, as_dict=True) for animal in repeat_breeders: todo = frappe.get_doc({ "doctype": "ToDo", "description": f"""⚠️ Problem Animal: Repeat Breeder

Animal: {animal.animal} ({animal.asset_name or ''})
Total Services: {animal.service_count}
Successful Pregnancies: 0
Last Service: {frappe.utils.formatdate(animal.last_service_date)}

Action Required:
• Veterinary examination
• Check for reproductive issues
• Consider culling if problem persists""", "reference_type": "Animal", "reference_name": animal.animal, "priority": "High", "status": "Open", "date": frappe.utils.nowdate() }) todo.insert(ignore_permissions=True) frappe.db.commit() # Log completion frappe.logger().info("Completed Daily Reproductive Alerts")

name: Get animals ready for service
script:
# Server Script Name: API - Get Animals Ready for Service
# Script Type: API
# API Method: get_animals_ready_for_service
# Description: Returns animals that completed post-partum period and ready for re-breeding
# NO IMPORTS, NO DEFS, NO RETURNS - SANDBOX COMPATIBLE

# Get animals ready for service
ready_animals = frappe.db.sql("""
    SELECT 
        ae.animal,
        a.burn_name AS asset_name,
        a.current_herd AS custom_current_herd,
        ae.event_date as calving_date,
        DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), ae.event_date) as days_since_calving,
        ae.ready_for_service_date
    FROM `tabAnimal Event` ae
    LEFT JOIN `tabAnimal` a ON ae.animal = a.name
    WHERE ae.event_type = 'Calving'
    AND ae.docstatus = 1
    AND DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), ae.event_date) >= 60
    AND NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM `tabAnimal Event` service
        WHERE service.animal = ae.animal
        AND service.event_type = 'Service'
        AND service.service_date > ae.event_date
        AND service.docstatus = 1
    )
    ORDER BY ae.event_date ASC
""", as_dict=True)

# Set response
frappe.response["message"] = ready_animals

name: Get animals needing pregnancy check
script:
# Server Script Name: API - Get Animals Needing Pregnancy Check
# Script Type: API
# API Method: get_animals_needing_pregnancy_check
# Description: Returns list of animals with pending pregnancy checks
# NO IMPORTS, NO DEFS, NO RETURNS - SANDBOX COMPATIBLE

# Get animals needing pregnancy check
animals_needing_check = frappe.db.sql("""
    SELECT 
        ae.animal,
        ae.name as service_event,
        ae.service_date,
        ae.pregnancy_check_due_date,
        DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), ae.service_date) as days_since_service,
        CASE
            WHEN DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), ae.pregnancy_check_due_date) > 20 THEN 'Overdue'
            WHEN DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), ae.pregnancy_check_due_date) > 0 THEN 'Due'
            ELSE 'Upcoming'
        END as urgency,
        a.burn_name AS asset_name,
        a.current_herd AS custom_current_herd
    FROM `tabAnimal Event` ae
    LEFT JOIN `tabAnimal` a ON ae.animal = a.name
    WHERE ae.event_type = 'Service'
    AND ae.pregnancy_confirmation_status = 'Pending'
    AND ae.docstatus = 1
    AND DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), ae.service_date) >= 21
    ORDER BY ae.pregnancy_check_due_date ASC
""", as_dict=True)

# Set response
frappe.response["message"] = animals_needing_check

name: Livestock Auto Journal Entry
Record Livestock Birth
script:
dam_name = frappe.form_dict.get('dam')
event_date = frappe.form_dict.get('event_date') or frappe.utils.today()
outcome = frappe.form_dict.get('outcome', 'Live Birth')
operator = frappe.form_dict.get('operator')
related_pregnancy = frappe.form_dict.get('related_pregnancy') or ''
remarks = frappe.form_dict.get('remarks') or ''
calves_json = frappe.form_dict.get('calves') or '[]'

if not dam_name:
    frappe.throw('dam is required')
if not operator:
    frappe.throw('operator is required')

dam = frappe.get_doc('Animal', dam_name)
if not dam:
    frappe.throw('Dam not found')

try:
    calves = json.loads(calves_json) if isinstance(calves_json, str) else (calves_json or [])
except Exception:
    calves = []

if not isinstance(calves, list) or not calves:
    frappe.throw('At least one calf is required')

num_calves = len(calves)

sire = ''
if related_pregnancy:
    try:
        preg_event = frappe.get_doc('Animal Event', related_pregnancy)
        if preg_event.related_service:
            svc_event = frappe.get_doc('Animal Event', preg_event.related_service)
            sire = svc_event.sire or ''
    except Exception:
        pass

calving_doc = {
    'doctype': 'Animal Event',
    'animal': dam_name,
    'event_type': 'Calving',
    'event_date': event_date,
    'current_herd': dam.current_herd or '',
    'custom_calving_outcome': outcome,
    'custom_no_of_calves': num_calves,
    'sire': sire,
    'operator': operator,
    'remarks': remarks
}
if num_calves == 1 and calves[0].get('sex'):
    calving_doc['custom_calf_sex'] = calves[0].get('sex')
if related_pregnancy:
    calving_doc['custom_related_pregnancy'] = related_pregnancy

calving_event = frappe.get_doc(calving_doc)
calving_event.flags.ignore_permissions = True
calving_event.insert(ignore_permissions=True)
calving_event.submit()

created_calves = []

if outcome == 'Live Birth':
    for calf in calves:
        calf_id = (calf.get('name') or '').strip().upper()
        if not calf_id or calf_id == 'STILLBORN':
            continue
        
        calf_sex = calf.get('sex') or ''
        calf_weight = float(calf.get('birth_weight') or 0)
        calf_herd = calf.get('herd') or dam.current_herd or ''
        calf_color = calf.get('color') or ''
        calf_value = float(calf.get('value') or 5000)
        
        animal_doc = {
            'doctype': 'Animal',
            'tag_number': calf_id,
            'burn_name': calf_id,
            'sex': calf_sex if calf_sex in ('Female', 'Male') else 'Female',
            'date_of_birth': event_date,
            'current_herd': calf_herd,
            'company': dam.company or 'Karen Roses',
            'dam': dam_name,
            'sire_name': sire,
            'birth_weight_kg': calf_weight,
            'coat_colour': calf_color,
            'origin': 'Born on Farm',
            'status': 'Active',
            'repro_status': 'Calf',
            'purchase_value': calf_value
        }
        if dam.breed:
            animal_doc['breed'] = dam.breed
        
        calf_asset = frappe.get_doc(animal_doc)
        calf_asset.flags.ignore_permissions = True
        calf_asset.insert(ignore_permissions=True)
        
        birth_remark = 'Dam: ' + (dam.tag_number or dam.burn_name)
        if sire:
            birth_remark = birth_remark + '. Sire: ' + sire
        birth_remark = birth_remark + '. Birth weight: ' + str(calf_weight) + ' kg'
        if calf_color:
            birth_remark = birth_remark + '. Color: ' + calf_color
        
        birth_event = frappe.get_doc({
            'doctype': 'Animal Event',
            'animal': calf_asset.name,
            'event_type': 'Birth',
            'event_date': event_date,
            'current_herd': calf_herd,
            'sire': sire,
            'operator': operator,
            'remarks': birth_remark
        })
        birth_event.flags.ignore_permissions = True
        birth_event.insert(ignore_permissions=True)
        birth_event.submit()
        
        created_calves.append({
            'asset': calf_asset.name,
            'name': calf_id,
            'sex': calf_sex,
            'birth_weight': calf_weight
        })

frappe.db.commit()

frappe.response['message'] = {
    'success': True,
    'calving_event': calving_event.name,
    'dam': dam_name,
    'dam_name': dam.tag_number or dam.burn_name,
    'outcome': outcome,
    'num_calves': num_calves,
    'calves': created_calves
}

name: Scrap Livestock Asset
script:
animal_name = frappe.form_dict.get('animal') or frappe.form_dict.get('asset_name')
reason = frappe.form_dict.get('reason') or ''
scrapping_date = frappe.form_dict.get('scrapping_date') or frappe.utils.today()

if not animal_name:
    frappe.throw('animal is required')

animal_doc = frappe.get_doc('Animal', animal_name)
asset_name = animal_doc.asset_link
if not asset_name:
    frappe.throw('Animal ' + str(animal_name) + ' is not capitalised (no linked Asset); cannot scrap.')

asset = frappe.get_doc('Asset', asset_name)

if asset.docstatus != 1:
    frappe.throw('Asset must be submitted before scrapping')

if asset.status in ('Cancelled', 'Sold', 'Scrapped'):
    frappe.throw('Asset is already ' + asset.status)

company = asset.company

# ── Fetch Company defaults ──
company_doc = frappe.get_doc('Company', company)
company_disposal_account = getattr(company_doc, 'disposal_account', None)
company_dep_expense_account = getattr(company_doc, 'depreciation_expense_account', None)
company_dep_cost_center = getattr(company_doc, 'depreciation_cost_center', None)
company_default_cost_center = company_doc.cost_center

# ── Fetch accounts from Asset Category ──
asset_category = asset.asset_category
category_fixed_asset_account = None
category_accumulated_dep = None
category_dep_expense = None

if asset_category:
    cat_doc = frappe.get_doc('Asset Category', asset_category)
    for row in cat_doc.accounts:
        if row.company_name == company:
            category_fixed_asset_account = row.fixed_asset_account
            category_accumulated_dep = getattr(row, 'accumulated_depreciation_account', None)
            category_dep_expense = getattr(row, 'depreciation_expense_account', None)
            break

# ── Resolve Disposal Account ──
# Priority: Company disposal account > Asset Category fixed asset account > search by name
disposal_account = company_disposal_account

if not disposal_account:
    try:
        disposal_account = frappe.get_cached_value('Company', company, 'gain_loss_on_asset_disposal')
    except Exception:
        pass

if not disposal_account:
    disposal_account = frappe.db.get_value(
        'Account',
        {'company': company, 'account_name': ['like', '%Gain%Loss%Asset%']},
        'name'
    )

# ── Resolve Depreciation Expense Account ──
# Priority: Asset Category > Company > search by name
depreciation_expense_account = category_dep_expense or company_dep_expense_account

if not depreciation_expense_account:
    depreciation_expense_account = frappe.db.get_value(
        'Account',
        {'company': company, 'root_type': 'Expense', 'account_name': ['like', '%Depreciation%']},
        'name'
    )

if not disposal_account or not depreciation_expense_account:
    frappe.throw('Please set Disposal Account and Depreciation Expense Account in Company ' + company + ' or in Asset Category ' + (asset_category or '(none)'))

# ── Resolve Cost Center: asset-level > company depreciation cost center > company default ──
cost_center = asset.cost_center or company_dep_cost_center or company_default_cost_center or ''

# ── Resolve Accumulated Depreciation Account for write-off ──
accumulated_dep_account = category_accumulated_dep
if not accumulated_dep_account:
    accumulated_dep_account = getattr(company_doc, 'accumulated_depreciation_account', None)

# ── Calculate values ──
gross_amount = asset.gross_purchase_amount or 0
accumulated_depreciation = asset.opening_accumulated_depreciation or 0
value_after_dep = asset.value_after_depreciation if asset.value_after_depreciation is not None else gross_amount

# ── Create Journal Entry ──
je = frappe.new_doc('Journal Entry')
je.voucher_type = 'Depreciation Entry'
je.naming_series = 'ACC-JV-.YYYY.-'
je.company = company
je.posting_date = scrapping_date
je.remark = 'Scrap Entry for asset ' + asset_name + ('. Reason: ' + reason if reason else '')

# Debit the disposal account (write off the remaining value)
je.append('accounts', {
    'account': disposal_account,
    'debit_in_account_currency': value_after_dep,
    'cost_center': cost_center
})

# If there is accumulated depreciation, debit it to clear the balance
if accumulated_depreciation and accumulated_dep_account:
    je.append('accounts', {
        'account': accumulated_dep_account,
        'debit_in_account_currency': accumulated_depreciation,
        'cost_center': cost_center
    })
    # Credit the fixed asset account for the full gross amount
    credit_account = category_fixed_asset_account or depreciation_expense_account
    je.append('accounts', {
        'account': credit_account,
        'credit_in_account_currency': gross_amount,
        'cost_center': cost_center,
        'reference_type': 'Asset',
        'reference_name': asset_name
    })
else:
    # Simple case: credit the depreciation expense account
    je.append('accounts', {
        'account': depreciation_expense_account,
        'credit_in_account_currency': value_after_dep,
        'cost_center': cost_center,
        'reference_type': 'Asset',
        'reference_name': asset_name
    })

je.insert(ignore_permissions=True)
je.submit()

# ── Update Asset status ──
update_fields = {
    'status': 'Scrapped',
    'journal_entry_for_scrap': je.name,
    'disposal_date': scrapping_date
}

if reason:
    update_fields['custom_reason_for_scrapping'] = reason

frappe.db.set_value('Asset', asset_name, update_fields)
frappe.db.set_value('Animal', animal_name, 'status', 'Dead')
frappe.db.commit()

frappe.response['message'] = {
    'success': True,
    'asset': asset_name,
    'status': 'Scrapped',
    'journal_entry': je.name,
    'reason': reason
}

name: Sell Livestock Asset
script:
animal_name = frappe.form_dict.get('animal') or frappe.form_dict.get('asset_name')
customer = frappe.form_dict.get('customer')
selling_amount = frappe.form_dict.get('selling_amount')
posting_date = frappe.form_dict.get('posting_date') or frappe.utils.today()
farm = frappe.form_dict.get('farm') or ''
business_unit = frappe.form_dict.get('business_unit') or ''

if not animal_name:
    frappe.throw('animal is required')
if not customer:
    frappe.throw('customer is required')
if not selling_amount:
    frappe.throw('selling_amount is required')

selling_amount = float(selling_amount)

animal_doc = frappe.get_doc('Animal', animal_name)
asset_name = animal_doc.asset_link
if not asset_name:
    frappe.throw('Animal ' + str(animal_name) + ' is not capitalised (no linked Asset); cannot sell as fixed asset.')
asset = frappe.get_doc('Asset', asset_name)

if asset.docstatus != 1:
    frappe.throw('Asset must be submitted before selling')

if asset.status in ('Cancelled', 'Sold', 'Scrapped'):
    frappe.throw('Asset is already ' + asset.status)

company = asset.company

company_doc = frappe.get_doc('Company', company)
company_currency = company_doc.default_currency or 'KES'
default_receivable = company_doc.default_receivable_account
default_expense = company_doc.default_expense_account
default_cost_center = company_doc.cost_center
default_income = company_doc.default_income_account

asset_category = asset.asset_category
category_fixed_asset_account = None

if asset_category:
    cat_doc = frappe.get_doc('Asset Category', asset_category)
    for row in cat_doc.accounts:
        if row.company_name == company:
            category_fixed_asset_account = row.fixed_asset_account
            break

disposal_account = None
try:
    disposal_account = frappe.get_cached_value('Company', company, 'disposal_account')
except Exception:
    pass

if not disposal_account:
    try:
        disposal_account = frappe.get_cached_value('Company', company, 'gain_loss_on_asset_disposal')
    except Exception:
        pass

if not disposal_account:
    disposal_account = category_fixed_asset_account or default_income

income_account = disposal_account or default_income
expense_account = default_expense
cost_center = asset.cost_center or default_cost_center
debit_to = default_receivable

default_price_list = frappe.db.get_value('Selling Settings', None, 'selling_price_list') or ''
price_list_currency = company_currency
plc_conversion_rate = 1

if default_price_list:
    pl_currency = frappe.db.get_value('Price List', default_price_list, 'currency')
    if pl_currency:
        price_list_currency = pl_currency
        if pl_currency != company_currency:
            try:
                plc_conversion_rate = frappe.db.get_value(
                    'Currency Exchange',
                    {'from_currency': pl_currency, 'to_currency': company_currency},
                    'exchange_rate',
                    order_by='date desc'
                ) or 1
            except Exception:
                plc_conversion_rate = 1

si = frappe.get_doc({
    'doctype': 'Sales Invoice',
    'customer': customer,
    'company': company,
    'posting_date': posting_date,
    'due_date': posting_date,
    'naming_series': 'SINV-.YYYY.-',
    'currency': company_currency,
    'conversion_rate': 1,
    'selling_price_list': default_price_list,
    'price_list_currency': price_list_currency,
    'plc_conversion_rate': plc_conversion_rate,
    'debit_to': debit_to,
    'update_stock': 0,
    'custom_farm': farm,
    'custom_business_unit': business_unit,
    'remarks': 'Livestock sale - ' + asset_name,
    'items': [{
        'item_code': asset.item_code or 'herd',
        'item_name': asset.item_name or asset.asset_name or 'herd',
        'description': 'Livestock sale: ' + (asset.asset_name or asset_name),
        'item_group': 'Assets',
        'stock_uom': 'Nos',
        'uom': 'Nos',
        'conversion_factor': 1,
        'qty': 1,
        'rate': selling_amount,
        'price_list_rate': selling_amount,
        'discount_percentage': 0,
        'income_account': income_account,
        'expense_account': expense_account,
        'is_fixed_asset': 1,
        'asset': asset_name,
        'cost_center': cost_center
    }]
})

si.flags.ignore_pricing_rule = True
si.flags.ignore_permissions = True
si.insert(ignore_permissions=True)

frappe.db.set_value('Animal', animal_name, 'status', 'Sold')
frappe.db.commit()

frappe.response['message'] = {
    'success': True,
    'asset': asset_name,
    'sales_invoice': si.name,
    'workflow_state': si.workflow_state or 'Draft',
    'customer': customer,
    'selling_amount': selling_amount,
    'grand_total': si.grand_total,
    'currency': si.currency
}
